data_description.providers: Select which joke sources to use. Note: "Geek Jokes" (mostly Chuck Norris / crude) and "Yo Mama Jokes" (roast humour) serve unfiltered adult content and are not family-friendly — both are off by default.

jokeapi.title: JokeAPI filters
jokeapi.description: Choose JokeAPI categories, content flags to exclude, and Safe Mode

data_description.jokeapi_categories: At least one category is required. If every category is selected, JokeAPI will use Any.
data_description.jokeapi_blacklist: Jokes matching these flags will not be served. Leave empty to allow flagged jokes.
data_description.jokeapi_safe_mode: When enabled, JokeAPI excludes flagged jokes and the Dark category. This is on by default to keep results family-friendly.

official.title: Official Joke API categories
official.description: Choose which Official Joke API types to draw from

data_description.official_categories: At least one category is required. A type is chosen at random from your selection each time a joke is fetched.
